svg.title: Ha Yanagi — Lament of the Willow. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Mourning Boughs forks into Veil of Falling Petals then Grave Willow's Hush, or Blight Takes Root then Hollow at the Heart. Whispering Canopy forks into Rising Sap then Thousand-Leaf Dream. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ha Yanagi-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

Its one meaningful row is Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit; Petal Nightmare's Damage row is static, 40 raw HP outside the EP ladder","rationale":"Three of the kit's six supported rows are enemy debuffs. Mourning Boughs answers \"How do I wither the enemy: blunt their blows or open them to every strike?\": Grave Willow's Hush takes both compounding Decrease Damage Given rows to +10% (Wailing Bark 45%, Petal Nightmare 40%), and Hollow at the Heart takes the single Blighted Tree exposure row to +8% (30 \u2192 38%, \u00d71.062); that capstone carries no suppression rider, but its route keeps Mourning Boughs' +2% Decrease Damage Given (+5% with Veil of Falling Petals). Whispering Canopy answers \"How do I make my own blows land harder?\" with one chain: Thousand-Leaf Dream takes the one Wailing Bark self buff to 45%. No node targets Damage: Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit is its one meaningful row, and Petal Nightmare's static row deals 40 raw HP. Every percentage row lists all four stat types and no element, so each reaches every non-pierce hit, not Genjutsu only. A Blighted Tree cast in the window lands \u00d71.45, and while its untreed 30% mark is also up your later hits land \u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.30 \u2248 \u00d71.89.","cost":4,"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagegiven":2},"finals":[{"jutsu":"Wailing Bark","row":0,"tag":"decreasedamagegiven","label":"Decrease Damage Given","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"ENEMY DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":2,"final":37.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Wailing Bark","row":1,"tag":"increasedamagegiven","label":"Increase Damage Given","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"self","role":"SELF BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":10,"final":45.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Blighted Tree","row":0,"tag":"damage","label":"Damage","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"DAMAGE","adverse":false,"base":40.0,"gain":0,"final":40.0,"calculation":"formula","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Blighted Tree","row":1,"tag":"increasedamagetaken","label":"Increase Damage Taken","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"ENEMY DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":30.0,"gain":0,"final":30.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Petal Nightmare","row":0,"tag":"damage","label":"Damage","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"DAMAGE","adverse":false,"base":40.0,"gain":0,"final":40.0,"calculation":"static","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false},{"jutsu":"Petal Nightmare","row":1,"tag":"decreasedamagegiven","label":"Decrease Damage Given","combat_elements":["None"],"recipient":"enemy","role":"ENEMY DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":30.0,"gain":2,"final":32.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Thousand-Leaf Dream"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on six rows; Decrease Damage Given (suppression), Increase Damage Taken (exposure) and Increase Damage Given (amplification) each own a route, and the fourth, Damage, reaches one meaningful row: Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit (60 AP, cooldown 7). Petal Nightmare's Damage row is static and deals its raw power, 40 HP before modifiers, so +N Damage there is +N HP. A flat-Damage capstone at the batch's +2 maximum (Blighted Tree 40 \u2192 42 EP) is \u00d71.05 on one hit every 7 rounds, less than Thousand-Leaf Dream's +10% gives that hit inside its window (\u00d71.45 / 1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.074) while the amplifier also lifts every other hit there, so the route would be outweighed; its percentage setup would either twin Rising Sap (an Increase Damage Given setup stacks with it through Thousand-Leaf Dream's fourth purchase) or repeat Veil of Falling Petals' or Blight Takes Root's tag on the same rows as a third commit. The pre-batch flat-Damage route (Hardened Heartwood \u2192 Nightmare in Bloom) is therefore not kept, and the Hardened Heartwood leaf is removed rather than kept only to avoid a universal node. Mourning Boughs is universal: it is in every legal 4-BP build, so the Amplifier build is fixed (06, 09, 10 + 01) and every build carries +2% Decrease Damage Given.","design_notes":["Structure: Mourning Boughs (enemy, universal) forks into Veil of Falling Petals \u2192 Grave Willow's Hush (suppression) and Blight Takes Root \u2192 Hollow at the Heart (exposure); Whispering Canopy (self) runs one chain, Rising Sap \u2192 Thousand-Leaf Dream (sustained amplification). Maxima over every legal allocation: Decrease Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +8%; no node targets Damage.","2026-10-04 rebalance: the pre-batch flat-Damage route (Hardened Heartwood \u2192 Nightmare in Bloom, +5 Damage: Blighted Tree formula 40 \u2192 45 EP, Normal \u2192 High; Petal Nightmare static 40 \u2192 45 raw HP) was cut, then removed; the roster pass also removes its Hardened Heartwood leaf (narrow-kit exception). Also in this batch: the +2% Decrease Damage Given rider on Hollow at the Heart is removed and Hollow at the Heart +7% \u2192 +5% (exposure +10% \u2192 +8%); Rising Sap +3% \u2192 +2% and Thousand-Leaf Dream +4% \u2192 +5%, so Amplifier stays +10% with the payoff on the capstone.","Fourth purchases: Suppression adds Whispering Canopy (+3% IDG) or Blight Takes Root (+3% IDT); Exposure adds Veil of Falling Petals (+5% DDG in all) or Whispering Canopy; Amplifier's fourth is always Mourning Boughs (+2% DDG). No fourth adds to its own route's primary tag, and none reaches more than half of a sibling route's primary.","Arithmetic: every percentage row lists all four stat types and no element, so each matches damage of any element (\u00a73). Jutsu-sourced increases multiply the hit in turn and reductions apply in sequence (computeDamagePacket, \u00a73b). Exposure with Whispering Canopy gives \u00d71.38 \u00d7 1.38 \u2248 \u00d71.90 on a hit inside both windows, Amplifier \u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.30 \u2248 \u00d71.89 with Blighted Tree's untreed mark up; Amplifier leads in the Wailing Bark window alone (\u00d71.45 against \u00d71.38), Exposure in the Blighted Tree window alone (\u00d71.38 against \u00d71.30) and on allies' hits. The +15% bloodline Increase Damage Given passive applies last; pierce runs after the modifier pass.","Delivery: all three casts are OTHER_USER SINGLE. Wailing Bark 40 AP, cooldown 6 (suppression row plus the self buff); Blighted Tree 60 AP, cooldown 7 (formula Damage plus exposure); Petal Nightmare 60 AP, cooldown 6 (static Damage, 40 raw HP, plus suppression). Every percentage row is live the two rounds after its cast, never in it, so no cast boosts its own hit. Both suppression debuffs on one target in one round cost 100 AP. Not simulated."],"risks":["Classification: no kit row carries an element, so the tree requires a classification extension. 'Ha Yanagi' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification assigned to jutsu records, not a bloodline-id selector; which jutsu carry it is a director/engine decision. All three kit jutsu qualify only through it (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit coverage is unverified.","Suppression stacking: Wailing Bark and Petal Nightmare each apply a separate two-round Decrease Damage Given debuff; with BATTLE_TAG_STACKING every active same-tag effect applies (process.ts 1109\u20131117, \u00a73b) and the reductions compound, so one target's non-pierce hits fall to \u00d70.65 \u00d7 0.70 = \u00d70.455 at base and \u00d70.55 \u00d7 0.60 = \u00d70.33 at the +10% route maximum (floor \u00d70.10). The strongest defensive package in the tree. Not simulated.","Downstream reach: the Wailing Bark self buff raises normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in its window; suppression cuts non-pierce damage from every source the target controls; exposure raises non-pierce hits from allies and weapons, so Hollow at the Heart is worth more in group fights than its single row suggests.","Single-row routes: Exposure (Blighted Tree, cooldown 7) and Amplifier (Wailing Bark, cooldown 6) each ride one row, live 2 rounds per cast. Exposure stops at +8%: at +10% it would equal Amplifier's gain on the caster's own hits (\u00d71.40 / 1.30 \u2248 \u00d71.077 against \u00d71.45 / 1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.074 per window) while adding allies' hits and the larger suppression fourth, leaving Amplifier only its cheaper, shorter-cooldown cast. Hollow at the Heart carries no suppression rider, but the route keeps Mourning Boughs' +2% Decrease Damage Given (+5% with Veil of Falling Petals). Amplifier keeps +10% on the one self row.","Targeting: all three casts are OTHER_USER and may be aimed at any living non-caster user, allies included (util.ts 2747\u20132749; actions.ts 1029\u20131068). Every damage and debuff row has friendly fire none/ALL, so aimed at an ally it damages, suppresses (up to 45%) or exposes (up to 38%) that ally; SINGLE method, so this is player-controlled.","Pierce and passives: no node touches pierce, and pierce runs after the modifier pass, so suppression and exposure do not change pierce hits. The bloodline's permanent +5% Increase Damage Taken passive (Taijutsu/Bukijutsu, no element) is not a jutsu row; no node raises or removes it.","Rank and scope: Ha Yanagi is a D-rank bloodline. No node changes either Damage row: Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit and Petal Nightmare's static 40 raw HP stay at base. Skill-tree effects are skipped in ranked modes; no combat simulation was performed."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":6,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["decreasedamagegiven","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":["damage"],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ha Yanagi-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. under a +10% single-row rule the capstone becomes +7%, route \u00d71.077); DQ-C (Grave Willow's Hush +10% Decrease Damage Given on two rows, Wailing Bark 35 \u2192 45% and Petal Nightmare 30 \u2192 40%, \u00d70.725 with both live, equal to Red Pestilence on the same bases); DQ-H (10 \u2192 8 nodes: the pre-batch flat-Damage route, Hardened Heartwood \u2192 Nightmare in Bloom, is removed, leaving three Advanced Arts, Mourning Boughs universal and Damage unamplified; narrow-kit exception).","concerns":["Mourning Boughs is universal (acknowledged in the narrow-kit exception): the Amplifier build is fixed (06, 09, 10 + 01) and every build carries +2% Decrease Damage Given. Grave Willow's Hush is single-tag where Red Pestilence carries a Decrease Damage Taken rider; the kit has no defensive self row, so this capstone reads lighter than the anchor.","Thousand-Leaf Dream is a bare single-row +10% Increase Damage Given capstone, where the anchors give +10% amplification a rider or stop at +8% (Arashima). Its fixed fourth makes the full build +10% Increase Damage Given, +2% Decrease Damage Given, close to Shakunetsu Sakura's Scorching Hanami package (+10% / +3%); the kit has no other rider tag that is not a sibling's primary.","The generated Damage-tier line labels Petal Nightmare's static row \"40 (Normal)\"; that row is 40 raw HP outside the player-jutsu EP ladder, so the label is a renderer limitation. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
HA YANAGI CLASSIFICATION · REQUIRES CLASSIFICATION EXTENSION
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ha Yanagi-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Grave Willow's Hush path + Whispering Canopy
Hollow at the Heart path + Veil of Falling Petals
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE HA YANAGI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree
